store_number.description: Proposed store number or site code.

address.description: Full street address of the proposed site.

market.description: Market or region name (e.g. Tampa FL, Dallas TX).

request_type.description: Type of feasibility request (initial, re-evaluation, expedited).

requester.description: Name and title of the person submitting the request.

priority.description: Priority level: CRITICAL, HIGH, STANDARD, or LOW.

source_document.description: Originating document name or email subject line.

feasibility_request.instructions: This is a store feasibility request. Extract project identifiers, location details, the requester, priority, and request type. If multiple stores are mentioned, extract the primary store being evaluated.

project_id.description: Project or store number this requirement applies to.

requirement_type.description: Type of requirement (zoning, setback, operational, environmental, etc.).

authority.description: Regulatory authority (e.g. City of Tampa Planning Division).

lead_time.description: Estimated lead time to satisfy the requirement (e.g. 90 days).

source_document.description: Name or reference of the source regulation or document.

municipal_requirement.instructions: This is a municipal regulatory requirement document for a store-development project. Extract the requirement type, the authority that imposes it, effective date, and estimated lead time. Focus on actionable requirements.

license_type.description: License type (e.g. Beer/Wine Off-Premises, Liquor Retail).

issuing_authority.description: State or local ABC authority issuing the license.

lead_time.description: Typical processing time for new application.

alcohol_license.instructions: This is an alcohol beverage license document. Extract the license type, issuing authority, validity dates, renewal period, and typical lead time for new applications.

license_type.description: Permit type (e.g. Tobacco Dealer Permit, Vapor Products Dealer).

issuing_authority.description: Issuing authority (state dept of revenue, county, etc.).

tobacco_license.instructions: This is a tobacco dealer permit or license document. Extract permit type, issuing authority, validity dates, renewal schedule, and lead time.

license_type.description: License type (e.g. Business Tax Receipt, Occupational License).

business_license.instructions: This is a business license or occupational license document. Extract the license type, issuing authority, validity dates, and typical lead time.

requirement_type.description: Zoning category or use type (e.g. C-2 Commercial, CU Conditional Use).

effective_date.description: Effective date of the zoning classification or approval.

lead_time.description: Estimated time to obtain zoning approval.

zoning_document.instructions: This is a zoning document, certificate, or variance approval. Extract the zoning classification, authority, effective date, and lead time for approval.

requirement_type.description: Permit type (building, signage, fire, fuel-dispensing, etc.).

permit.instructions: This is an operational permit. Extract the permit type, issuing authority, validity dates, and typical lead time for new applications.

project_id.description: Project or store number this response references.

request_type.description: Type of the original request being answered.

responder.description: Name/title of the person who provided the response.

historical_response.instructions: This is a prior response to a feasibility request or municipal inquiry. Extract who responded, when, for which municipality and project, and the nature of the original request.

requirement_type.description: Type of requirement that changed (zoning, license, setback, etc.).

authority.description: Regulatory authority that issued the change.

source_document.description: Ordinance number, notice reference, or document name.

regulatory_change.instructions: This is a regulatory change notice or ordinance amendment affecting store-development compliance. Extract the municipality, requirement type that changed, effective date, and the issuing authority.

requester.description: Internal contact who engaged the consultant.

request_type.description: Topic of correspondence (zoning, licensing, feasibility, etc.).

source_document.description: Email subject, letter reference, or document title.

consultant_correspondence.instructions: This is correspondence between company staff and an external consultant, attorney, or government liaison. Extract the project, municipality, parties, topic, and date.
